syscalls.comment: High-risk syscalls stay hard-denied even during discovery. These are almost never legitimately needed by a web server and should not be whitelisted just because complain-mode happened to log them.

Deliberately minimal seed allow-list: just enough for the container's init process and dynamic linker to start. Everything nginx itself needs at runtime (socket, bind, listen, accept4, epoll_*, sendfile, etc.) is intentionally left OFF this list so it falls through to SCMP_ACT_LOG and shows up in the audit log — that log output IS the discovery result.
